title: ascocentrum aurantiacum
intro: Ascocentrum aurantiacum, commonly known as the Orange Ascocentrum or Butterfly Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its vibrant orange flowers and is prized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ascocentrum aurantiacum include its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, improving blood flow, and acting as an antioxidant.
